items.title: Musk Says He Offered the FAA Free Starlinks and Was Told They Weren’t Needed
items.summary: Musk says the FAA turned down free Starlinks right before a ground stop cancelled thousands of flights. Officials blame a rogue router inside the agency's own network, which raises a harder question about whether satellites could have helped at all.

items.title: L3Harris Technologies (LHX) Router Outage Puts Air Traffic Upgrades In Focus
items.summary: L3Harris Technologies (NYSE:LHX) is under scrutiny after an FAA system outage was tied to a router software upgrade supplied by the contractor. The disruption triggered nationwide flight delays and cancellations as air traffic control centers relied on manual procedures during the outage. U.S. transportation officials and lawmakers are using the incident to push for broad modernization of FAA network and air traffic infrastructure.
